subject: PrivDeploy audit readiness & runbook — next steps
messages:
From: MediNova Security <security@medinova.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Perez <carlos.perez@medinova.io>
Date: 2027-05-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment — audit readiness & evidence we need

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement and InfoSec at MediNova want to capture what evidence and operational controls Redwood will provide for an on-prem (air-gapped / customer-run) deployment. High-level asks from our side:

- License boundary: exactly what binary/artifacts and configuration are delivered vs what remains managed by Redwood.
- Auditability: how we demonstrate you delivered an operator snapshot and that it can be restored in our environment. Hashing/signing expectations, frequency of snapshots.
- Operator access model: operator roles, emergency access, break-glass procedures, and attestation evidence.
- Evidence package formats: SOC2 artifacts, deployment checklist, runbook excerpts, and sample audit logs.
- Escrow-like path: if needed, what can be deposited (image, artifacts, keys), and what lifecycle controls exist on that deposit.

Can you provide a runbook and a short timeline (we have an internal procurement deadline of May 19) plus any redlineable language for the MSA/order form we should circulate to our legal team?

If helpful, loop in your legal and delivery folks — happy to jump on a 30-minute sync.

Cheers,
Rita Chatterjee
Head of InfoSec, MediNova
security@medinova.io

Attachment: medinova_soc2_request.xlsx (spreadsheet of requested artifacts)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: MediNova Security <security@medinova.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — audit readiness & evidence we need

Rita — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura (legal) and Avery (ops/delivery). Quick proposal below and next steps.

Summary proposal (short):
- We will deliver: a signed operator image bundle (hash + signature), a delivery manifest, a deployment runbook extract, and a 90-day sample of anonymized audit logs demonstrating operator actions.
- Snapshot cadence: initial deliverable + quarterly snapshots by default; weekly snapshots can be configured as an add-on. Snapshots include SHA256 manifest and PGP signature.
- Operator access model: default is customer-controlled operator accounts; Redwood can provide a monitored operator fallback for emergency only, governed by a documented break-glass runbook and two-person attestation.
- Escrow path: we can put a snapshot bundle in a time-locked transfer with a neutral escrow steward or provide a signed image deposit to your custody. Exact wording needed in the MSA.

Attachments I'm sharing: redwood_privdeploy_runbook_v0.2.pdf (runbook extract + checklist) and a first-pass Order Form language (see comments in doc). Laura — can you flag any legal landmines in the runbook/OF language?

Proposed timeline:
- May 3: legal redlines exchanged
- May 6: joint sync (30m) to align on license boundary and escrow options
- May 12: final OF redlines submitted to procurement

Next steps:
1) Laura & Avery to review attachments and provide concrete redline suggestions for MSA/OF by EOD May 3.
2) Rita to confirm availability for a 30m sync May 6–7.

Thanks — happy to adjust if you have a tighter procurement cutoff.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: redwood_privdeploy_runbook_v0.2.pdf (runbook excerpt, checklist), OrderForm_DRAFT_20270502.docx (inline comments)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, MediNova Security <security@medinova.io>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-03T14:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — audit readiness & evidence we need

Rita / Sean / team — thanks for the context. I reviewed the runbook and the draft order form and have attached redlines and a prioritized questions list. High-level items for Medinova legal to confirm:

1) License scope clarity — we need to replace the phrase "deployment artifacts" with a defined Exhibit (Exhibit A: Delivered Artifacts) listing images, manifests, signed scripts, and configuration templates. That reduces back-and-forth during procurement.
2) Operational control carveouts — propose language that the customer retains sole control over customer operator accounts; Redwood operator access is subject to documented incident criteria and two-person approval. Suggest adding an audit trail attestation exhibit.
3) Escrow / deposit mechanism — redwood proposes a signed image deposit to a mutually agreed neutral escrow (third-party), with access provided only on joint written authorization or contract termination for breach. If MediNova prefers key-handback over escrow, we need precise acceptance criteria.
4) Evidence delivery cadence — define minimum deliverables (initial bundle within 5 business days of order, quarterly snapshots, and on-request ephemeral snapshots with 5 business days notice).
5) Indemnity & IP carveouts — narrow the MSA language to confirm Redwood's delivered artifacts are licensed, not transferred; include a limited license to run and operate in perpetuity for the agreed deployment.

I attached: MSA_redlines_20270503.pdf and OrderForm_DRAFT_20270503.docx (comments inline).

Questions for procurement:
- Will Medinova accept Redwood's neutral escrow steward proposal? (If yes, we can share recommended providers.)
- Do you require operator credential escrow, or only image/artifact escrow?
- Any additional compliance evidence (beyond SOC2) we should plan to package?

I can jump on the May 6 sync and will have redlineable MSA language ready by EOD May 3.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 650-555-0133

Attachments: MSA_redlines_20270503.pdf (redline PDF), OrderForm_DRAFT_20270503.docx (tracked changes)

Laura / Sean — appreciate the quick turnaround and the detailed options. A few notes from procurement/infosec after an internal review: 

- Neutral escrow steward: OK in principle. Please share your recommended providers and a sample escrow statement for quick review.
- Operator credential escrow: we prefer image/artifact deposit only; credential handback will be via our PKI workflow if needed.
- Additional evidence: we will request a short attestations package for the initial deliverable (deployment manifest + PGP-signed hash list + delivery checklist) and the SOC2 artifacts you already referenced.

We'll take a first pass at the MSA redlines and share by May 11. For the sync on May 6 — Rita/Carlos and a lawyer from our procurement team (copying Carlos for scheduling) are available May 6 at 09:00 PT.
